title: alert.created payload, v1
description:
Published on `alert.created.v1` when an assessment opens an alert for human review.

Keyed by ALERT id, not account (ADR-0006): an alert's transitions must be ordered with respect to each other and have no ordering relationship with any other alert.

An alert is a workflow, not a row. This event is where that workflow begins.

accountId.description: Carried for correlation. NOT the partition key on this topic.

status.description: Always NEW on creation. Constrained rather than merely documented, so a producer bug cannot emit a created event in a later state.

summary.description: Short analyst-facing description of why this alert exists. Never contains raw payload data.

topReasonCode.description: The single largest contributor, duplicated from the assessment so a queue view can render a row without joining.
